name: Legal-marketing ethics opinions, 2004–2026
description: An index of US state and ABA ethics opinions, committee guidelines and court rulings on lawyer advertising and marketing, from 2004 to 2026 (most from 2015 on, plus earlier landmarks): lead generators, pay-per-lead, reviews, testimonials, trade names, websites, social media, chatbots and AI tools, competitor keywords and more. Version 1.1 adds an AI sub-index: 14 AI opinions coded on six marketing questions (chatbot disclosure, AI-made ads, intake and solicitation, superiority claims, confidentiality in marketing tools, and fees). Each record gives the issuing body, number, date, topics, a one-sentence holding in our words, a practical step, whether it is still in force, the official link, an exact short quote and the date read. It is not the opinions' full text.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Legal-marketing ethics opinions, 2004–2026 (Version 2.0.2) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24114753

distribution.name: opinions.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: opinions.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: opinions-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in opinions-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to opinions.csv on id.

recordSet.name: opinions
recordSet.description: The records of Legal-marketing ethics opinions, 2004–2026, one per CSV row.

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter state code, DC, US (federal), ABA, or PLATFORM:<name>

field.name: body
field.description: The body that issued the opinion

field.name: opinionType
field.description: formal, advisory, informal, committee-guideline or court

field.name: bindingWeight
field.description: How much weight it carries: advisory-committee, committee-guideline or court

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: whatToDo
field.description: What a law firm should do about it, in one sentence

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
